text: Prepare the Aimparency recursive proof artifact for SPC
description: Create a concise, inspectable account of how the SPC objective, constraints, decisions, corrections, phase, human gates, and executor work were represented in the idea graph. The proof must demonstrate operational continuity and human authority without asking reviewers to admire a gimmick. Include concrete examples of Codex being directed, corrected, or blocked by human-dependent ideas.

status.comment: SPC application was cancelled (Felix 2026-10-16: not eligible, no more grants); the proof document stays in meta/applications/spc-founder-fellowship-2026/.

valueRationale: The process can provide differentiated product evidence if presented as a compact operational artifact rather than the application’s main claim.
